from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper with its citation relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly references")
    cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that explicitly cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
